name: agent-devenv-autoexec
displayName: Flag Dev Tools That Run Code on Open
description: Warns only (observe): flags files that make a dev tool run code on open, clone or shell entry -- agent hooks, helpers, env/BASE_URL overrides, auto-approve; VS Code folderOpen tasks, trust off, repo executables; devcontainer initializeCommand; .envrc, mise, husky, lefthook, pre-commit; gitconfig exec keys, gitattributes drivers, unsafe .gitmodules. Commit, agent write, turn's end; additions only; unreadable configs refused. Friction: misses interpreted code and unlisted files. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo. In Cursor the turn's end is not held: a refusal there is handed back to the agent as a follow-up message, once, and a hook that fails to answer lets the turn end.]
